explanation: The theorem is about the library's own constructs (JZero, reductionModL, heckeGen, frobeniusPushforwardModL, Pic0.torsion, modularFunctionFieldC). Its proof uses only library-local lemmas (heckeModuleBar_heckeGen_smul, reductionModL_heckeOperatorBar, heckeOperatorModL_eq_frobeniusPushforwardModL_...). Mathlib has no Hecke operators on Jacobians of modular curves, no Eichler–Shimura relation, and no Pic0 of function fields. I did not run searches in the Mathlib sources, because these constants are not Mathlib notions.
